pokedexEntries.ru: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.

pokedexEntries.sa: LOMBRE’s entire body is covered by a slippery, slimy film. It feels horribly unpleasant to be touched by this POKéMON’s hands. LOMBRE is often mistaken for a human child.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

pokedexEntries.em: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
